note: Gate C W1 — C01 (Quiet day), C02 (Decision day), C03 (Matchday pre-live, League and Event, PREPARE/VERIFY/IMMINENT). No official Gate C wave-ordering document exists (see SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md) — this wave's scope is self-assigned and provisional, per the handoff brief's own fallback instruction. An independent review of this PR's first pass found three genuine production defects (P1-01 contradictory quiet-day/Matchday messaging, P1-02 busy same-day chronology never visible on a quiet-composition day, P1-03 squad-readiness/carry-forward duplication into the context rail) and three fixture-integrity gaps (P2-01 non-deterministic clock, P2-02 unscoped hrefs, P2-03 count-cap-only duplicate-suppression coverage) — all six are now fixed; see CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md, DATA_TRUTH_AND_FIXTURES.md, and INTERACTION_AND_STATE_AUDIT.md for the full detail. C01 and all six C03 candidates now carry a real PROPOSED_REFINEMENT (implemented) baselineAssetRef reflecting the P1-01/P1-02/P1-03 production fixes; C02 remains CONFIRMS_SHIPPED_BASELINE with a materially stronger identity-collision fixture (P2-03). C07 (Assistant Coach fallback) and C04-C06/C08 (Round Board) remain explicitly deferred — see BLOCKERS.md. All eight candidates remain CANDIDATE pending owner review. A pre-existing, unrelated Visual Authority Gate fingerprint-staleness defect (issue #827) is also tracked separately and is not resolved by, or a blocker to, this remediation. A SECOND independent review found the first remediation's own P1-03 context-rail fix introduced two new information-loss defects: P1-04 (organisation-wide squad availability, from getOrgActivePlayerAvailability(), disappeared whenever a Matchday anchor existed, wrongly treated as the same fact as Matchday's own match-specific readiness) and P1-05 (carry-forward items beyond the first were silently dropped on quiet days, not just deduplicated). Both are now corrected: C01 and all six C03 candidates carry fixtureVersion 3 and an updated componentOwners list including today-context-rail.tsx. See CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md and INFORMATION_OWNERSHIP_MATRIX.md for the full detail.
